title: Christian betrays Jungle Boy
summary: The trusted mentor turns against Jungle Boy, making their conflict personal and drawing Luchasaurus into the split.

chapters.title: The mentor turns
chapters.result: Christian attacks Jungle Boy after Jurassic Express lose the tag titles.
chapters.context: The championship loss is followed by a betrayal from inside the team’s corner.

chapters.title: Jungle Boy survives Luchasaurus
chapters.result: Jungle Boy defeats Luchasaurus in a steel cage.
chapters.context: He overcomes his former partner on the way back to Christian.

chapters.title: The Final Burial
chapters.result: Jack Perry defeats Christian in the Final Burial match.
chapters.context: Perry closes the casket on the mentor who betrayed him.
